ApproveRequest.description: Approve a proposal, optionally editing its copy for one feed's audience and language.
ApproveRequest.title: ApproveRequest

AudienceBody.description: The same insight written for each audience.
AudienceBody.title: AudienceBody

AuditRecord.description: A state change, who made it, and what it changed.
AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord

BootSwing.description: A goal that changed the top of the Golden Boot race. Written by code, citable.
BootSwing.title: BootSwing

held.description: The producer has paused automatic cuts.

pinned_match_id.description: The producer has fixed the feed on a match.

signals.description: Every live match, most deserving first.

log.description: What the Director, Watchers, and producer did.

agents.description: The Watcher and Director agents are connected.

ChannelLog.description: One line of the channel's log: who did what, when.
ChannelLog.title: ChannelLog

Claim.description: A factual statement made by a proposal. Every claim cites the events that support it.
Claim.title: Claim

ClockRequest.description:
Move the matchday clock (a demo control): to `minute` minutes played (as
MATCH_START_MINUTE counts them: 55 is where a cold start begins), or, with no minute, to the
moment the day's last match ends.
ClockRequest.title: ClockRequest

replay_event_id.description: Open with a replay of this goal or chance.

also_match_id.description: A split screen: the match the cut left, kept beside it while it matters.

also_why.description: Why that match stays on screen (code-written).

CutPackage.description: What the viewer is told when the feed cuts to a match.

at_stake.description: What a goal here would change in the table.

story.description: The story of this match so far.

written_by.description: 'code', or the agents that wrote it.

for_you.description: On a personal whip-around: what this match means to you.

storyline.description: A player's story here (the Golden Boot race, a milestone...), by code.

CutPackage.title: CutPackage

DrillRequest.description:
Start a drill: `blip` fails the agent's next model call once (the retry recovers it);
`down` fails every call for a few minutes (the system falls back).
DrillRequest.title: DrillRequest

DrillState.description: The drill now: which agent is failing and how, or none.

seconds_left.description: Until a `down` drill ends by itself.

DrillState.title: DrillState

EventAttributes.description: Measurements attached to an event. Which ones are set depends on the event type.

ball_speed_kmh.description: Ball speed; on shots this is the shot speed.

player_speed_kmh.description: The acting player's speed at the moment of the event.

distance_covered_m.description: The acting player's cumulative distance this match.

EventAttributes.title: EventAttributes

EventImpact.description: How much one action changed the game for the acting team.

threat.description: Expected threat added (negative when possession is lost).

EventImpact.title: EventImpact

FantasyItem.description: One line of a fantasy player's score, with the events that earned it.
FantasyItem.title: FantasyItem

on_pitch.description: On the pitch now (or at full time).

GoldenBoot.description: The season's top scorers as it stands, and the goals that changed the top of the race.
GoldenBoot.title: GoldenBoot

KeyMoment.description: A defining play, ranked by importance, with the events that make it up.
KeyMoment.title: KeyMoment

matchday_number.description: Which round of the season this is.

last_matchday.description: The season's last: the title and the drop are decided.

swings.description: Every zone change so far today, oldest first.

stakes.description: For each live match and side, what a goal would do.

Lens.description: Whose whip-around this is: everyone's channel, a fan's club, or a fan's fantasy XI.

points.description: The fantasy XI's total, as it stands.

Lens.title: Lens

LiveEvent.description: A match event as it happens, with how much it mattered.
LiveEvent.title: LiveEvent

LocalizedText.description: One piece of copy per supported language. English is always present.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

MatchCard.description: One match on the match centre: score, clock, a momentum ribbon, and its biggest moment.
MatchCard.title: MatchCard

MatchDetail.description: Everything needed to open a match: the card, stats, key moments, squads, and recent play.
MatchDetail.title: MatchDetail

MatchEvent.description: A single timed event in a synthetic match.
MatchEvent.title: MatchEvent

MatchRecap.description:
One match's recap at its final whistle: written by its Watcher and checked (or by code,
from its goals, if every draft failed its checks or the agents are off).
MatchRecap.title: MatchRecap

score.description: How much the match deserves the screen right now.

matchday_number.description: Which round of the season this is.

last_matchday.description: The season's last: the title and the drop are decided.

Moment.description: Something worth surfacing, grounded in the events that triggered it.
Moment.title: Moment

OnAir.description: An approved graphic on air. Each viewer renders it for their own feed profile.
OnAir.title: OnAir

OverlayCommand.description: Rendered for one output feed: `profile_id` names the ViewerProfile it was made for.
OverlayCommand.title: OverlayCommand

PendingCut.description: The Director's next cut, counting down. The producer can take it now or hold it.
PendingCut.title: PendingCut

PitchPoint.description: Normalized pitch coordinates (0-100 on both axes). x runs in the home attacking direction.
PitchPoint.title: PitchPoint

PlayerPosition.description: One player's position. Players can stand just off the pitch (throw-ins), hence the margin.
PlayerPosition.title: PlayerPosition

Proposal.description:
A candidate graphic or line. It must make at least one cited claim: no narration without
receipts. `headline` and `body` are both written per audience and language.

player_id.description: The player this is about; drives player tags and player focus.

Proposal.title: Proposal

Recap.description:
How a matchday unfolded: written by the recap writer agent and checked (or by code, if
every draft failed its checks or the agents are off), beside where code says the day left
the table. On the season's last matchday that is how the season ended.

status.description: pending: matches still playing; writing: the agent is on it; ready.

season_over.description: The season's last matchday: the top is the champions.

bottom_three.description: The relegation places: relegated, if the season is over.

checks.description: What the checkers sent back on the way, if anything.

Recap.title: Recap

fact_ids.description: The facts this beat rests on.

RecapFact.description:
One fact written by code: an outcome, a goal that moved the table or the Golden Boot, or
a final score. The recap's beats cite these by id.

fact_id.description: A goal ('<match_id>:<event_id>'), a final score ('ft:<match_id>'), or an outcome ('final:<what>').

RecapFact.title: RecapFact

label.description: One line, e.g. 'Ambrose scores for Halvern Town'.

as_it_stands.description: What the goal changed in the table, e.g. 'As it stands: Halvern Town go top'.

events.description: The events in the window, oldest first.

pressure.description: Something about to happen: recent threat, shots.

stake.description: What a goal for this side would change (table weight).

Squads.description: Every player in the league, for picking a fantasy XI, and a suggested XI.

rules.description: How fantasy points are scored, one rule per line.

Squads.title: Squads

Stake.description: What one more goal for one side in one live match would change in the table right now.

weight.description: How much the change matters: title and drop 1, top four 0.5.

Stake.title: Stake

result.description: Today's match as it stands (or as it ended).

TableSwing.description: A goal that changed the table's zones: who moved where. Written by code, citable.

summary.description: One sentence, e.g. 'Halvern Town go top on goal difference.'

TableSwing.title: TableSwing

TakeRequest.description: Take the pending cut now (no match_id), or cut straight to a match.
TakeRequest.title: TakeRequest

field_tilt_pct.description: Share of both teams' final-third passes made by this team.

TrackingFrame.description:
All 22 players and the ball at one match-clock instant. Streamed alongside MatchEvents so
the control room can draw formations moving in sync with the actions.
TrackingFrame.title: TrackingFrame

ViewerProfile.description: Setting `focus_player_id` turns on player-focus mode for the feed.

spotlight_metric.description: The single performance metric this viewer cares about.

ViewerProfile.title: ViewerProfile

ZoneChange.description: One club moving into or out of a zone.
ZoneChange.title: ZoneChange
